paragraphs.zh: HTTP 负载生成器，ApacheBench (ab) 的替代品

paragraphs.en: hey is a tiny program that sends some load to a web application.
paragraphs.zh: hey 是一个向 Web 应用发送一些负载的小程序。

paragraphs.en: hey was originally called boom and was influenced from Tarek Ziade's tool at tarekziade/boom . Using the same name was a mistake as it resulted in cases where binary name conflicts created confusion. To preserve the name for its original owner, we renamed this project to hey.
paragraphs.zh: hey 最初叫 boom，并受到了 Tarek Ziade 的工具（tarekziade/boom）的影响。 使用相同的名字是一个错误，因为二进制文件名冲突造成了一些混乱。 为了把名字保留给其最初的主人，我们将这个项目重命名为 hey。

sents.en: hey was originally called boom and was influenced from Tarek Ziade's tool at tarekziade/boom .
sents.zh: hey 最初叫 boom，并受到了 Tarek Ziade 的工具（tarekziade/boom）的影响。

sents.en: Using the same name was a mistake as it resulted in cases where binary name conflicts created confusion.
sents.zh: 使用相同的名字是一个错误，因为二进制文件名冲突造成了一些混乱。

sents.en: To preserve the name for its original owner, we renamed this project to hey.
sents.zh: 为了把名字保留给其最初的主人，我们将这个项目重命名为 hey。

paragraphs.en: hey runs provided number of requests in the provided concurrency level and prints stats.
paragraphs.zh: hey 会在给定的并发级别下运行指定数量的请求，并打印统计信息。

paragraphs.en: Usage: hey [options...] <url> Options: -n Number of requests to run. Default is 200. -c Number of workers to run concurrently. Total number of requests cannot be smaller than the concurrency level. Default is 50. -q Rate limit, in queries per second (QPS) per worker. Default is no rate limit. -z Duration of application to send requests. When duration is reached, application stops and exits. If duration is specified, n is ignored. Examples: -z 10s -z 3m. -o Output type. If none provided, a summary is printed. "csv" is the only supported alternative. Dumps the response metrics in comma-separated values format. -m HTTP method, one of GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS. -H Custom HTTP header. You can specify as many as needed by repeating the flag. For example, -H "Accept: text/html" -H "Content-Type: application/xml" . -t Timeout for each request in seconds. Default is 20, use 0 for infinite. -A HTTP Accept header. -d HTTP request body. -D HTTP request body from file. For example, /home/user/file.txt or ./file.txt. -T Content-type, defaults to "text/html". -a Basic authentication, username:password. -x HTTP Proxy address as host:port. -h2 Enable HTTP/2. -host HTTP Host header. -disable-compression Disable compression. -disable-keepalive Disable keep-alive, prevents re-use of TCP connections between different HTTP requests. -disable-redirects Disable following of HTTP redirects -cpus Number of used cpu cores. (default for current machine is 8 cores) Examples Make requests with default settings:
paragraphs.zh: 用法：hey [选项...] <url> 选项：-n 运行的请求数量。 默认值为 200。-c 并发运行的工作进程（worker）数量。 请求总数不能小于并发级别。 默认值为 50。-q 速率限制，即每个工作进程每秒的查询数（QPS）。 默认不限制速率。-z 发送请求的应用持续时间。 达到持续时间后，应用停止并退出。 如果指定了持续时间，则 n 会被忽略。 示例：-z 10s -z 3m。-o 输出类型。 如果未提供，则打印摘要。 "csv" 是唯一支持的替代格式。 以逗号分隔值（CSV）格式导出响应指标。-m HTTP 方法，可为 GET、POST、PUT、DELETE、HEAD、OPTIONS 之一。-H 自定义 HTTP 头。 可以通过重复该标志来指定任意数量的自定义头。 例如：-H "Accept: text/html" -H "Content-Type: application/xml"。-t 每个请求的超时时间（秒）。 默认值为 20，设为 0 表示无限。-A HTTP Accept 头。-d HTTP 请求体。-D 从文件读取 HTTP 请求体。 例如 /home/user/file.txt 或 ./file.txt。-T Content-type，默认为 "text/html"。-a 基本认证，格式为 username:password。-x HTTP 代理地址，格式为 host:port。-h2 启用 HTTP/2。-host HTTP Host 头。-disable-compression 禁用压缩。-disable-keepalive 禁用 keep-alive，防止在不同 HTTP 请求之间重用 TCP 连接。-disable-redirects 禁用跟随 HTTP 重定向 -cpus 使用的 CPU 核心数。 （当前机器默认为 8 核）示例 使用默认设置发起请求：

sents.en: Usage: hey [options...] <url> Options: -n Number of requests to run.
sents.zh: 用法：hey [选项...] <url> 选项：-n 运行的请求数量。

sents.en: Default is 200. -c Number of workers to run concurrently.
sents.zh: 默认值为 200。-c 并发运行的工作进程（worker）数量。

sents.en: Total number of requests cannot be smaller than the concurrency level.
sents.zh: 请求总数不能小于并发级别。

sents.en: Default is 50. -q Rate limit, in queries per second (QPS) per worker.
sents.zh: 默认值为 50。-q 速率限制，即每个工作进程每秒的查询数（QPS）。

sents.en: Default is no rate limit. -z Duration of application to send requests.
sents.zh: 默认不限制速率。-z 发送请求的应用持续时间。

sents.en: When duration is reached, application stops and exits.
sents.zh: 达到持续时间后，应用停止并退出。

sents.en: If duration is specified, n is ignored.
sents.zh: 如果指定了持续时间，则 n 会被忽略。

sents.en: If none provided, a summary is printed.
sents.zh: 如果未提供，则打印摘要。
"csv" 是唯一支持的替代格式。

sents.en: Dumps the response metrics in comma-separated values format. -m HTTP method, one of GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS. -H Custom HTTP header.
sents.zh: 以逗号分隔值（CSV）格式导出响应指标。-m HTTP 方法，可为 GET、POST、PUT、DELETE、HEAD、OPTIONS 之一。-H 自定义 HTTP 头。

sents.en: You can specify as many as needed by repeating the flag.
sents.zh: 可以通过重复该标志来指定任意数量的自定义头。

sents.en: For example, -H "Accept: text/html" -H "Content-Type: application/xml" . -t Timeout for each request in seconds.
sents.zh: 例如：-H "Accept: text/html" -H "Content-Type: application/xml"。-t 每个请求的超时时间（秒）。

sents.en: Default is 20, use 0 for infinite. -A HTTP Accept header. -d HTTP request body. -D HTTP request body from file.
sents.zh: 默认值为 20，设为 0 表示无限。-A HTTP Accept 头。-d HTTP 请求体。-D 从文件读取 HTTP 请求体。

sents.en: For example, /home/user/file.txt or ./file.txt. -T Content-type, defaults to "text/html". -a Basic authentication, username:password. -x HTTP Proxy address as host:port. -h2 Enable HTTP/2. -host HTTP Host header. -disable-compression Disable compression. -disable-keepalive Disable keep-alive, prevents re-use of TCP connections between different HTTP requests. -disable-redirects Disable following of HTTP redirects -cpus Number of used cpu cores.
sents.zh: 例如 /home/user/file.txt 或 ./file.txt。-T Content-type，默认为 "text/html"。-a 基本认证，格式为 username:password。-x HTTP 代理地址，格式为 host:port。-h2 启用 HTTP/2。-host HTTP Host 头。-disable-compression 禁用压缩。-disable-keepalive 禁用 keep-alive，防止在不同 HTTP 请求之间重用 TCP 连接。-disable-redirects 禁用跟随 HTTP 重定向 -cpus 使用的 CPU 核心数。

sents.en: (default for current machine is 8 cores) Examples Make requests with default settings:
sents.zh: （当前机器默认为 8 核）示例 使用默认设置发起请求：

paragraphs.en: hey https://google.com Make 1000 requests with 100 concurrent workers:
paragraphs.zh: 嘿 https://google.com 使用100个并发工作线程发出1000个请求：

paragraphs.en: hey -n 1000 -c 100 https://google.com Run load test for 30 seconds:
paragraphs.zh: hey -n 1000 -c 100 https://google.com 运行 30 秒的负载测试：

paragraphs.en: hey -z 30s https://google.com Make POST request with custom body:
paragraphs.zh: hey -z 30s https://google.com 发送带有自定义请求体的 POST 请求：

paragraphs.en: hey \ -m POST \ -d "param1=value1&param2=value2" \ https://google.com Add custom headers:
paragraphs.zh:
```
hey \ -m POST \ -d "param1=value1&param2=value2" \ https://google.com
```

添加自定义请求头：

paragraphs.en: hey \ -H "Accept: application/json" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer token" \ https://google.com Test with HTTP/2:
paragraphs.zh: hey \ -H "Accept: application/json" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer token" \ https://google.com 使用 HTTP/2 进行测试：

paragraphs.en: hey -h2 https://google.com Rate limit to 10 queries per second per worker:
paragraphs.zh: hey -h2 https://google.com 将每个工作进程的速率限制为每秒 10 次查询：

paragraphs.en: hey -q 10 -c 5 -z 30s https://google.com About HTTP load generator, ApacheBench (ab) replacement
paragraphs.zh: hey -q 10 -c 5 -z 30s https://google.com 关于：HTTP 负载生成器，ApacheBench (ab) 的替代品
